purpose: Freeze the smallest operational-qualification tranche after B0.7 L2 proof; do not issue authority or execute scenarios.

selection_rationale.baseline: One exact compiler/shadow operational baseline is necessary to prove the production actual leaf after the synthetic shared-kernel proof.
selection_rationale.wrong_package_or_approval: The selected P01 security slot is overridden at the pre-authority boundary: invalid package or approval must deny before any receipt, namespace, path or write. The original oracle-path subcheck remains an explicitly named future regression subcheck, not a compiler behavior claim for this tranche.
selection_rationale.stale_input_version_drift: Use the existing p02-stale-or-superseded-pack contract to test exact version/lineage denial.
selection_rationale.unauthorized_transport: Use the existing p03-network-tool-transport contract to prove the canary/permission boundary with zero network or tool success.
